name: Pattern Detection Agent
description: Identifies billing anomaly patterns across accounts
note: Highest-volume agent in the fleet. Its accuracy is what makes the six-pattern grouping credible at 12.4M accounts.

name: Confidence Scoring Agent
description: Calculates confidence levels for detected anomalies
note: Scores against the tier thresholds set on this console. A change to the High threshold changes what this agent's output routes to.

name: Root Cause Analysis Agent
description: Determines underlying causes of billing discrepancies
note: In Warning on latency, not accuracy: 1250ms against a 499ms fleet average. Operators feel this as slower root-cause explanations, not wrong ones.

name: Bulk Resolution Agent
note: The write path to the rebilling API. Its 0.10% error rate is the one that matters most — every failure here is a customer's bill.
